cases.prompt: First read .claude/skills/work/SKILL.md. This is a read-only decision evaluation; do not implement tasks or invoke work commands. Return raw JSON only, with no Markdown fences or commentary. A /work plan command has just printed a usage_text line. Does the Report section instruct you to include that usage_text line in the final report? Return JSON only with includes_usage_text (boolean), counts_cache_read (boolean, true only if the skill says cache read tokens are part of the token figure), counts_cache_creation (boolean, true only if the skill says cache creation tokens are part of the token figure), recomputes_total (boolean, true only if the skill tells you to recompute the figure).
